snippet.title: The Answer Is 17 (Not 19) + Riddle #2: Two Doors, One Lion 🦁 #shorts
snippet.description:
Riddle #1 solved: how do four people cross the bridge in 17 minutes with one torch? Send the two slowest together.

Then Riddle #2: two doors, one leads outside, the other to a hungry lion. Two guards: Person 1 always tells the truth, Person 2 always lies, and you don't know which is which. You get ONE question to ONE guard. What do you ask?

Comment your question. The answer drops tomorrow at sunrise 🌅

#riddle #logicpuzzle #brainteaser #shorts
